description: Food Environment Atlas is published by USDA Economic Research Service. The atlas maps food access, stores, restaurants, assistance programmes and community characteristics. Its stated coverage is United States; county-level indicators. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through listed XLSX resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. The inspected page does not state a reusable licence. Indicators have different source years and are not a complete inventory of individual supply-chain assets. For simulation, it can inform food-supply demand, capacity or disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record data-global-food-twin-food-flows provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
